measured.intro: Generated by `python -m tools.verifier_recall` on full leagues 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030. Cases and the true-case definition: `tests/verifier_cases.py`. Recall is k/n with a Wilson 95% interval (a count when there are fewer than 40 cases). Versions (all evaluated on the same recorded claim scopes): v2 = before the recall work; v3 = non-penalty shot_spam, trailing box-entry share and the full-time tilt window; v4 = v3 plus the chaser-threat condition (the current code). Seeds 2026-2028 were used to choose the changes; 2029-2030 are the hold-out.

notes.heading: Reading these numbers
notes.text: field_tilt_with_lead on one full-match claim per team: 0.54 [0.44-0.64], n=85 on the tuning seeds 2026-2028, but 0.43 [0.30-0.56], n=54 on the hold-out seeds 2029-2030. The changes (including the chaser-threat line at the league's 75th percentile) were chosen on the tuning seeds, so the hold-out figure is the honest one for this level.

notes.heading: Reading these numbers
notes.text: The same rule in the Analyst pipeline, the figure users experience: 0.85 [0.76-0.91], n=85 (tuning) and 0.87 [0.76-0.94], n=54 (hold-out). The pipeline proposes a field tilt claim for every 30-minute window above 60% tilt, several per match, and a case counts as caught when any of them fires, so a window the rule misses is often caught by a neighbouring one. A full-match claim has one chance, its box-entry and threat figures are averaged over the whole match, and the league's threat line for full matches is tighter than for 30-minute windows (less spread: 1.11-1.16 against 1.31-1.39 on these leagues).

notes.heading: Reading these numbers
notes.text: Analyst-pipeline unplanted fire rate, outcome label on total xG: before the changes 16.1% of 3230 unplanted cases: 9.6% justified, 2.0% unclear, 4.6% real false positives; now 13.8% of 3230 unplanted cases: 11.1% justified, 2.1% unclear, 0.6% real false positives. The before figures are the old rules re-applied to the claim scopes recorded in this run (the Analyst's windows do not depend on the rules).

labels.rule: High press / Low press: pressure events per opponent pass attempted, at least 3 percentage points above / below the league average, with a 95% interval that excludes the league average. Otherwise league-typical.

labels.label: Patient
labels.rule: Direct / Patient: share of open-play passes that go forward (x gain >= 8), at least 3 percentage points above / below the league average, with a 95% interval that excludes the league average. Otherwise league-typical.

labels.label: Cedes territory
labels.rule: Territorial / Cedes territory: share of all final-third passes in its matches that are its own, at least 3 percentage points above / below the league average, with a 95% interval that excludes the league average. Otherwise league-typical.

labels.label: Few counters
labels.rule: Counter-attacking / Few counters: share of its passing sequences that are counter-attacks, at least 3 percentage points above / below the league average, with a 95% interval that excludes the league average. Otherwise league-typical.
